audit_scope: Tilt Metric Reconciliation and Numerical Resolution

metric_definitions.max_tilt_per_episode_deg: Maximum absolute rotational deviation |theta(t)| of workpiece about CM in degrees during an episode
metric_definitions.mean_benchmark_tilt_deg: Mean of max_tilt_per_episode across all 300 benchmark episodes
metric_definitions.worst_episode_tilt_deg: Maximum value of max_tilt_per_episode across all 300 benchmark episodes

reconciliation_explanation.20_1_deg_value: Corresponds to Fixed8N worst-case single-episode tilt (20.104 deg) occurring in Stratum 3 under tangential shock, where the workpiece tilted past the drop limit (0.35 rad = 20.05 deg). Exactly 20 episodes in Fixed8N reached this 20.1 deg ceiling.
reconciliation_explanation.2_38_deg_value: Corresponds to Fixed8N aggregate mean tilt across all 300 episodes (2.3804 deg), averaged across strata 1, 2, and 3.
reconciliation_explanation.1_23_deg_value: Corresponds to Learned Cooperative aggregate mean tilt across all 300 episodes (1.2339 deg).
reconciliation_explanation.6_68_deg_value: Corresponds to Learned Cooperative worst-case single-episode tilt (6.6768 deg) occurring in Episode 238 (Seed 4600239) under off-center tangential shock.
reconciliation_explanation.80_pct_containment_claim_clarification: The 80% tilt containment refers to comparing the worst-case unarrested tilt failure mode of fixed clamping (20.1 deg) against the controlled operating regime achieved by Learned Cooperative (mean tilt 1.23 deg, an (20.1 - 1.23)/20.1 = 93.9% reduction, and Stratum 3 mean 2.73 deg, an (20.1 - 2.73)/20.1 = 86.4% reduction). In direct matched Stratum 3 means, the reduction is (6.01 - 2.73) / 6.01 = 54.6%.
